title: Rioni Valley Defenders’ Namakhvani HPP camp/vigil (pre-February continuation)
notes: HRC reports a peaceful gathering of about 500 at Namokhvani on 2021-02-07, demanding the HPP construction stop and ENKA leave the Rioni gorge; it describes the camp as reaching day 106 on February 8. Civil Georgia later says the Rioni Gorge camp was maintaining rotating shifts for over 100 days by February 28. These sources show a pre-February campaign and continued camp activity, but do not establish the exact start/end or an uninterrupted physical occupation. The 500 reported for February 7 and the Kutaisi February 28 rally are separate crowd/event observations; do not carry the count between days or merge E002 into this continuation.
